premises.text: People lose good ideas because files are scattered across email, desktop, Dropbox, and other repositories
premises.evidence_span: Have you ever had a really good idea and then lost it?

premises.text: Docurated discovers files across repositories, strips formatting into individually indexed pages/charts/text/images, and ranks them by content and context relevance that learns from use
premises.evidence_span: We ought to discover all of your files across any repository, email, desktop, third parties

premises.text: Natural language processing analyzes content so users never have to tag anything
premises.evidence_span: You don't ever have to tag anything. We will analyze your words, we will analyze your ideas, and we will tell you what your content is about

premises.text: Users mash up pages from any file format into visual collages, then export to PowerPoint/PDF or share/save from anywhere
premises.evidence_span: Each page can be mashed up from any other page, from any other file format

premises.text: Beyond large enterprises, Docurated is offered to anyone with a Dropbox account
premises.evidence_span: We believe that DocuRated belongs to everyone. So today, I bring DocuRated to you. If you have a Dropbox account, DocuRated is yours

value.text: Users get one place where ideas and best content are at their fingertips, searchable and reusable
value.evidence_span: We just need one place where all of our ideas are at our fingertips

causal_links.evidence_span: Finding ideas is a huge problem
your best content, your best page, not a file, your best page appears to you in the order of relevance
All of your ideas are in a visual, beautiful collage, each waiting to be used in a different and new way
If you have a Dropbox account, DocuRated is yours

notes: Discover/strip/index/relevance-learning folded as one search-brains mechanism; NLP no-tagging kept as package of that mechanism (§4.1.7). Collage mashup/export/share split as separately demoed beauty/remix path. Customer testimonial treated as evidence, not new premises. $9B enterprise spend treated as market framing. Four-domain partition; not a need/product/money triad.
